verdict.rationale: Chronicle documents trace ingestion through its SDK or an OpenTelemetry exporter, and shows requests, changes and scores in Timeline, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence says traces can capture images, audio, or file payloads. Generic trace and event ingestion is adjacent and does not show multimodal payload capture.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture multimodal payloads (images, audio, files) inside my traces
